study_system.system: James River riverine rock-pool network, Virginia, USA
study_system.scientific_role: fresh EOG-specific independent validation candidate for the post-Glanville label-invariant Layer-B predictor

independence_boundary.rule: Published aggregate event counts are used only to establish plausible estimability and comparator relevance. They may not tune worlds, Layer-B features, holdout, models, metrics, or favourable/adverse thresholds.
independence_boundary.label: fresh EOG-specific validation; not completely outcome-naive ecological-system validation

source.dataset_title: Regional and local factors interact to shape colonization and extinction dynamics of invasive Hydrilla verticillata in a patchy landscape
source.source_freeze_rule: Freeze the latest published Dryad version, every file name/size/API checksum, and exact downloaded bytes before any response row is parsed.

public_process_basis.node_definition: 506 rock pools were randomly selected as the monitored patch universe rather than selected by future Hydrilla occupancy.
public_process_basis.survey_semantics: Hydrilla presence/non-detection was recorded by trained visual surveys; opportunistic within-day repeat surveys were used to estimate detection probability.
public_process_basis.dynamic_process: The publication reports annual/temporal colonization, extinction, and persistence in a patchy riverine pool network.
public_process_basis.external_source_uncertainty: the James River channel is described as a potential propagule source; Gate 0 must establish whether a response-free distance-to-river representation is available before claiming internal process closure.
public_process_basis.claim_boundary: Any EOG forecast will be conditional on declared recorded pool sources and any prospectively represented river-source state; no unique historical route is inferred.

event_count_feasibility_gate.basis: 133 reported colonization events greatly exceeds the prior Chiricahua minimum-event failure and makes a frozen heldout transition endpoint plausible.

node_geometry_gate.critical_question: Does the release provide response-free stable pool IDs plus complete coordinates or a complete pairwise distance representation for the 506-pool universe?
allowed_inputs: All_dist.csv if its schema is response-free
near_neigh_dist.csv if its schema is response-free
bounded first physical records of every other text table
pass_if: 506 stable pool identities can be frozen independently of occupancy
complete pool geometry is available as coordinates or all unordered pairwise distances
geometry rows contain no occupancy, colonization, extinction, abundance, or future-response selection
distance units and symmetry/completeness can be audited
stop_if: only nearest-neighbour or distance-to-river summaries are released
complete geometry requires opening response-bearing All_Data rows
pool identities cannot be reconciled without response values
geometry is restricted to occupied or eventually occupied pools

response_semantics_gate.candidate_target: survey-recorded annual pool colonization among surveyed previously non-detected pools
response_semantics_gate.positive_candidate: surveyed pool recorded occupied in target period after a prior surveyed non-detection state
response_semantics_gate.negative_candidate: surveyed pool with documented non-detection in target period while still in the colonization risk set
response_semantics_gate.missing_candidate: not surveyed or otherwise unavailable pool-period; excluded rather than recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.detection_requirement: The final comparator contract must use the archived repeat-survey structure or a detection-aware external model; raw non-detection is not asserted to be certain biological absence.
response_semantics_gate.stop_if: Survey effort/missingness cannot be distinguished from recorded non-detection before response scoring.

allowed_at_gate0: Dryad version/file metadata and exact byte checksums
full tables only after a bounded header proves they are response-free and the contract explicitly whitelists their role
bounded first physical record of response-bearing or ambiguous CSV files via eog.v2.validation.read_bounded_first_record_text

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen process/structural rule identities retained for compatibility, sequential contraction, and finite-universe falsification

structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.scale_rule: reuse the unchanged response-blind 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 largest-component ladder on complete pool geometry
requirements: at least three distinct positive thresholds
structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.no_rescue: Do not add kNN, river-distance-only pseudo-geometry, or arbitrary thresholds after a structural failure.

prospective_source_gate_after_geometry.internal_sources: recorded occupied pools at the preceding eligible period
prospective_source_gate_after_geometry.river_source: must be represented prospectively as an external source world if response-free distance-to-river information is available and public process evidence requires it
prospective_source_gate_after_geometry.stop_if: Neither internal-source conditionality nor an explicit external river source can represent the documented colonization process without opening/tuning on outcome rows.

external_comparator_classes: detection-aware dynamic occupancy model using frozen local pool/flooding covariates
single-process connectivity model based on currently occupied pools and/or explicit river-source distance
fixed flexible classifier using only the same prospectively frozen response-free inputs

pass_if_all: exact Dryad bytes and metadata are reproducibly frozen
the 506-pool node universe is future-response independent
surveyed non-detection can be separated from missing/not-surveyed periods
source closure can be represented prospectively
published aggregate colonization counts support plausible estimability
stop_if_any: complete geometry is absent or response-bearing
survey semantics cannot distinguish non-detection from missing
documented external recruitment cannot be represented prospectively

post_gate0_sequence: freeze canonical pool universe and complete response-free geometry
freeze source-state and river-source world semantics
freeze temporal/spatial holdout and unchanged Layer-B representation
synthetic-smoke the complete once-only runner without response rows
open response once and preserve favourable, null, adverse, universe-falsified, or non-estimable result
no_rescue_rule: If Gate 0 or Gate 1 fails, close the candidate unmerged and move on. Do not redesign its geometry or endpoint after opening response-bearing data.
